chunks: And when We bestow favour upon man, he turns away and moves to the side; and when evil touches him, he is one with a wide supplication.
ai.seo_question: How does human behavior change between times of ease and times of hardship according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tafsir as highlighting the 'fitrah' (innate nature) of human inconsistency, illustrates how blessings often lead to heedlessness (ghaflah) while trials awaken spiritual urgency. Scholars note that this duality serves as a diagnostic tool for self-reflection, urging believers to maintain gratitude during ease and patience during hardship, rather than oscillating between arrogance and desperation.
